name: Puah
bio: Puah is one of two midwives who attended the Hebrew women in Egypt. Alongside her fellow midwife Shiphrah, she defied Pharaoh's order to kill every Hebrew baby boy because she feared God, risking her own life to preserve countless Hebrew infants — including, eventually, Israel's future deliverer, Moses (Exodus 1:15-21). Together, the two midwives are Scripture's earliest recorded example of women openly resisting an unjust government's orders out of fear of God.
